tasks.title: Enforce external configuration
tasks.objective: Make missing Neo4j or embedding credentials a typed blocking condition with no hardcoded fallback.
steps: Export resolveExternalProductionConfig(configuration, context).
Reject each missing Neo4j URI, username, password, and embedding credential independently with EXTERNAL_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED and error.field.
Block both credential-free startup and semantic-query operations.
Remove direct URI, username, password, and provider credential literals plus logical, nullish, and ternary fallback behavior.
Use the structured source policy to reject credential-tainted query and parameter variables at Cypher execution calls.
Keep provider credentials out of Cypher parameters and query text.
tasks.completionSignal: runExternalCredentialBoundary.js passes all isolated fields, start/query blocking, structured source/Cypher scans, and credential-source-policy.guard.js passes all bypass and safe fixtures without production runtime composition.

tasks.title: Implement embedding qualification gate
tasks.objective: Block index delivery unless provider, model, version, and dimensions are explicitly human-approved.
steps: Export evaluateEmbeddingQualification(qualification).
Require approvedByHuman === true; reject undefined, strings, numbers, objects, arrays, and every other non-boolean value.
Reject undefined and whitespace-only provider, model identity, and version independently with error.field.
Require dimensions to satisfy Number.isInteger(dimensions) && dimensions > 0 without coercion.
Reject any implicit-default source before index delivery.
tasks.completionSignal: runEmbeddingQualificationGate.js passes exact-boolean approval, undefined/blank identity, invalid dimension type/range, and implicit-default matrices without production runtime composition or selecting a model.

tasks.title: Enforce canonical projection authority
tasks.objective: Ensure Neo4j retrieval evidence cannot redefine approved canonical intent.
steps: Export enforceCanonicalProjectionAuthority(input).
Compare projection canonical version and identities with injected canonical state.
Reject conflicts with CANONICAL_PROJECTION_CONFLICT or replace them with canonical state.
Preserve the existing no-argument complete snapshot.
tasks.completionSignal: runCanonicalProjectionAuthority.js independently passes without production runtime composition, runCanonicalGraphFullSnapshot.js remains green, and projection-only identities are never observable.

Use only externally configured neo4j-driver connectivity in production composition.
Return platform, canonical version, object type, and canonical identity for each seed.
